units.name: The UOR Foundation
units.purpose: The primary purpose of the Corporation shall be to develop a universal data standard for the semantic web, open science, and frontier technologies.

units.name: Board of Directors
units.purpose: The affairs of the Corporation shall be managed by its Board of Directors (the "Board").

units.name: Technical Oversight Committee
units.purpose: Responsible for stewarding the UOR Framework specification, open-source repositories, and public API infrastructure.

units.name: Community and Outreach Committee
units.purpose: Responsible for supporting the open developer, researcher, and practitioner community engaged with the UOR Framework.

units.name: Advisors to the Board
units.purpose: Serves in an advisory capacity only, with no right to vote on Board decisions.

stages.name: Sandbox
stages.evidence: Clear use case, active maintainer, basic repo hygiene

stages.name: Incubation
stages.evidence: Versioned releases/APIs, contribution activity, early adopters

stages.name: Graduated
stages.evidence: Multi-org maintainership, security posture, demonstrable adoption

stages.name: Archived
stages.evidence: Sustained inactivity, maintainer request, or supersession

rungs.name: Warning
rungs.event: A violation involving a single incident or series of incidents.
rungs.consequence: A private, written warning from the Community Moderators.

rungs.name: Temporarily Limited Activities
rungs.event: A repeated incidence of a violation that previously resulted in a warning, or the first incidence of a more serious violation.
rungs.consequence: A private, written warning with a time-limited cooldown period designed to underscore the seriousness of the situation and give the community members involved time to process the incident. The cooldown period may be limited to particular communication channels or interactions with particular community members.

rungs.name: Temporary Suspension
rungs.event: A pattern of repeated violation which the Community Moderators have tried to address with warnings, or a single serious violation.
rungs.consequence: A private written warning with conditions for return from suspension. In general, temporary suspensions give the person being suspended time to reflect upon their behavior and possible corrective actions.

rungs.name: Permanent Ban
rungs.event: A pattern of repeated code of conduct violations that other steps on the ladder have failed to resolve, or a violation so serious that the Community Moderators determine there is no way to keep the community safe with this person as a member.
rungs.consequence: Access to all community spaces, tools, and communication channels is removed. In general, permanent bans should be rarely used, should have strong reasoning behind them, and should only be resorted to if working through other remedies has failed to change the behavior.
